name: Hourglass
author: nixfred
description: Screen time for Omarchy. Tracks which app has focus, second by second, straight off the Hyprland socket, and shows where the day went: a 24-hour focus ribbon, app ring, 7-day stack, focus sessions, longest streak and context switches. Nudges you to stand up after a long unbroken stretch. Local only, window classes only, never titles.

barWidget.description: Active screen time today. Click for where it went.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar rereads today's totals. Tracking itself samples every 2 s regardless.

schema.label: Stretch nudge after (minutes)
schema.description: The glyph pulses once you have been active this long without a 5 minute break. 0 turns it off.

schema.label: Show the focused app
schema.description: Adds the app you are in and its unbroken run beside the total.
